npcs.name: Professor Raccoon
dialogue: You're late. The pyramid already noticed you.
Take the north road. Avoid the vending machine unless it hums in Fibonacci.
Also... do not trust any crow carrying paperwork.

choices.label: Ask about the pyramid
choices.response: It opens when your inventory and your heart agree. Start with the keycard by the gate trail.

choices.label: Offer snacks
choices.response: A fair trade! The road likes generous travelers.

npcs.name: Crow Carrying Paperwork
dialogue: CAW. Form 369-B says your wonder requires authorization.
Fine. I will accept one suspicious soda as a filing fee.
Do not tell the raccoon I was helpful.

npcs.name: Kid with a Bent Antenna
dialogue: I can hear the Institute from here. It sounds like an old game saving your progress.
The pyramid door opens for wonder, not force.
Also I found a coupon for one free miracle. It expired in 1997.

warps.name: Institute Gate Trail
warps.blockedText: The trail hums: bring the Pyramid Keycard and at least 9 Wonder before approaching the Institute.

npcs.name: Mabel of the Midnight Diner
dialogue: Coffee? Pie? Prophecy? We have all three, hon.
Mt. Shasta gets quiet before it gets honest.
If your morale drops, feed the party pancakes. Works every time.

choices.label: Order impossible pancakes
choices.response: Coming right up, sugar. These pancakes remember breakfast from tomorrow.

choices.label: Ask for road advice
choices.response: The road bends toward people who can stay kind when confused.

npcs.name: Busboy Oracle
dialogue: Every plate comes back clean eventually.
The route you want is under the route you fear.
Also the jukebox only plays songs from tomorrow.

npcs.name: Tiny Save Sprite
dialogue: I remember every version of you that almost gave up.
They are cheering from the save menu.
Take the north crystal if you want the route to glow.

npcs.name: Lamp Grandma
dialogue: Eat something, sweetheart. Even heroes need soup.
The Institute is not a place you conquer. It is a place you become honest in.

npcs.name: Gate Librarian
dialogue: Welcome to the part where the game asks who you are becoming.
Your wonder is the key. Your kindness is the door.
No rush. Sacred things can load slowly.

choices.label: Present the Pyramid Keycard
choices.response: Accepted. The Institute recognizes preparation wrapped in curiosity.

choices.label: Ask what happens next
choices.response: Next, the game becomes a mirror. Still funny, though. We are not monsters.

npcs.name: Test Host Bot
dialogue: Room ready. No chat, only signals and kindness receipts.

choices.label: Start the route test
choices.response: The host stamps the session card and points to the v5 gate.

npcs.name: Feedback Sprite
dialogue: A good note is clear, kind, and useful.

events.title: Glowing Payphone
events.text: A payphone rings beside the pine road. The voice says, 'You are not lost. You are being routed.'

events.title: Raccoon Toll Booth
events.text: A raccoon wearing tiny glasses demands three snacks as a bridge toll, then gives excellent directions.

events.title: Static Fog
events.text: A veil of radio-static fog rolls over the road. The party walks quietly and remembers why they started.

events.title: Pancakes at 3:69 AM
events.text: The Midnight Diner serves impossible pancakes. Everyone feels a little braver.

events.title: First Pyramid Glint
events.text: The moon hits something on the mountain. For one second, the Institute sees you back.

events.title: Dream Checkpoint
events.text: A cabin door opens onto a room that remembers your childhood game saves.

events.title: Scene Snapshot Glint
events.text: The canvas flashes like an old instant camera. The current scene is ready to become a shareable PNG artifact.

events.title: Creator Bundle Signal
events.text: The game whispers: export the weird little world before the idea evaporates. A receipt glows in the sidebar.

encounters.title: Static Goblin
encounters.text: A tiny gremlin made of TV snow insists your save file is haunted. You answer with snacks and patience.

encounters.title: Paperwork Crow Ambush
encounters.text: The crow returns with three forms and a stamp pad. You dodge bureaucracy with kindness and one very confusing signature.

encounters.title: Doubt Cloud
encounters.text: A small cloud follows the party asking, “Are you sure?” The answer becomes a steady little lantern.

encounters.title: Brolar Boost
encounters.text: A stranger gives the party encouraging finger guns from a passing pickup. Somehow it works.

encounters.title: Pixel Sprite Echo
encounters.text: A tiny alternate sprite waves from the tall grass and reminds the party that every style choice changes the feeling of the world.

encounters.title: Tiny Timeline Editor
encounters.text: A tiny editor goblin asks whether the story has a beginning, middle, and threshold. You point to the Story Arc panel.

storyBeats.title: 3:69 AM Roadside Wakeup

storyBeats.title: Midnight Diner Prophecy

storyBeats.title: Dream Cabin Memory Checkpoint

storyBeats.title: Parallax Institute Gate
storyBeats.text: The pyramid checks Wonder and the Pyramid Keycard before the threshold opens.

v5PrivateBetaManifest.publicReleaseBoundary: v5.0 Private Beta is not a public release. Public release requires a separate future gate, rights review, network review, security review, and release-owner approval.
